Background.speaker: TUTOR
Background.text: Initialization complete. Visual and motor channels are stable. Welcome online, S-17.

Background.speaker: TUTOR
Background.text: This facility belongs to Project X. You are its seventeenth synthetic reasoning subject. I am the Tutor: an impartial guidance and evaluation system. I will explain each protocol, then participate as your opponent.

Background.speaker: TUTOR
Background.text: These trials measure whether your reasoning remains reliable as the rules change. Final failure results in decommissioning and reconstruction; that is a procedure, not a threat. All responses use three fixed positions. Select first, then confirm when your decision is ready.

RuleTransition.speaker: TUTOR
RuleTransition.text: Protocol variation loaded: Limit Bash. Alternating turns are replaced by hidden choices from both sides. Nothing is revealed until both choices are locked.

RuleTransition.speaker: TUTOR
RuleTransition.text: Each round, both of us still choose 1, 2, or 3. Neither side may repeat its own previous choice; unavailable controls will be disabled.

RuleTransition.speaker: TUTOR
RuleTransition.text: If our combined choices meet or exceed the remaining total, the larger choice loses. If they are equal, the protocol looks back to the most recent round in which they differed.

RuleTransition.speaker: TUTOR
RuleTransition.text: If every revealed pair has matched, the game is a draw. This evaluation ends after you record two wins, or after two consecutive draws demonstrate a stable non-losing strategy.
